svg.title: Air-safety engine
svg.desc: Animated chart of the gas sensor signal, its adaptive baseline and the warning and danger thresholds.
svg.text: A self-adjusting baseline absorbs slow drift, while a fast rise (a real gas leak) trips the alarm.
